name: BACH_0356_FSIM_blur3
markdown:
## Bottom line
**Suggests InSitu (77%)** · Unreliable input · Defer to expert
Severe blur flags this simulated frozen section as unreliable [F6], and the conformal set includes Invasive (21%) [F1].

## Confidence
| Signal | Value | Reading |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Top probabilities | InSitu 77%, Invasive 21%, Benign 1%, Normal 0% | Favors InSitu; 21% invasive risk |
| Conformal set | InSitu, Invasive (90% target; 90% test coverage, n=132) | Cannot exclude invasive carcinoma |
| Reliability / OOD | 30% reliability (flagged), 100th percentile OOD, severity-3 blur | Unreliable, out-of-distribution input |
| CONCH–MUSK agreement | Disagree on top class | Independent foundation models disagree |
| Similar cases | 1/5 InSitu (20%), 4/5 Invasive (71%–76% similarity) [F5] | Reference neighbors favor Invasive |

## Tissue evidence
- **Normal lobules with two-layered epithelium** (region 3) · ↑ invasive · Below-typical score (+0.83), but 0/20 AI spot check is unreliable [F2] · Unreliable
- **Benign fibrous stroma or fat** (region 4) · ↑ invasive · Below-typical score (+0.61 push); 20/20 AI spot-checked [F3] · Validated
- **Dense lymphocytic infiltrate (TILs)** (region 3) · context · Below-typical descriptive score (+0.43); 8/20 AI spot-checked [F4] · Weak
- **Tumor infiltrating stroma** (region 3) · ↓ invasive · Below-average score (-0.26 push); 19/20 AI spot-checked · Validated
- **Tumor necrosis** (regions 7, 11) · ↑ invasive · Elevated score (+0.16), but 3/20 AI spot check is unreliable · Unreliable

## Trust check
- **Heatmap**: Faithful to classifier; removing top 3 risk regions drops invasive probability above random (+0.0114, 95% CI +0.0021 to +0.0197).
- **Concepts**: Unproven faithfulness (deletion 95% CI -0.0088 to +0.0064 includes 0); leans on unreliable normal lobules (0/20) and necrosis (3/20).

## Could be wrong if
- Severity-3 blur and 100th-percentile OOD degradation obscure invasion, as 4 of 5 similar cases are Invasive.
- Contrast case BACH_0379 (76% similar) is Invasive, differing in invasion (validated) and mitoses (unreliable, 0/20 spot check).

## Check on the slide
1. **Regions 9, 10, 7, 5**: Highest heatmap risk (99%–100%); inspect for stromal invasion versus in situ carcinoma.
2. **Regions 3, 4**: Top invasion and stroma tiles (97% and 75% risk); verify basement membrane integrity.
3. **Regions 0–11**: Defer margin call [F7]; review drafted recut H&E and deeper levels (stains blocked).
